blocks.text: for va since — ikkalasi ham «-dan beri»

**for** va **since** qizil kitobda tanishtirilgan (→ qizil kitob, 18–19-darslar), How long have you ...? savoli esa 11-darsda (→ 11-dars). Bu darsda asosiy qiyinchilikka to'xtalamiz: o'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham bitta qo'shimcha bilan beriladi — «**ikki yildan beri**» va «**2020-yildan beri**». Ingliz tilida esa tanlov «-dan beri» oldidagi so'zga bog'liq: u **muddat** (qancha vaqt) bo'lsa — **for**, **boshlanish nuqtasi** (qachondan) bo'lsa — **since**. Holat hozir ham davom etayotgan bo'lsa, fe'l Present Perfect yoki Present Perfect Continuous da turadi (→ 9–11-darslar).

rows: for **ages**, for **a long time**, for **a while**

items.text: Dilnoza has been a doctor **for ten years**.
Dilnoza has been a doctor **since her graduation**.
I haven't checked my email **since this morning**.

blocks.text: When ...? va How long ...? — ikki xil savol

Bitta vaziyatga ikki xil savol berish mumkin. **When did** it start? — harakat **qachon boshlangan**: bu o'tmishdagi bir nuqta, shuning uchun Past Simple, javobi — in May, last week, two years **ago**. **How long have** you ...? — boshlanganidan **hozirgacha qancha vaqt** o'tgan: bu hozirga ulangan davr, shuning uchun Present Perfect, javobi — **for** ... yoki **since** .... «When have you started?» deyilmaydi: when tugagan nuqtani so'raydi (→ 14-dars).

**How long are you staying?** (yoki How long are you here for?) — kelajak haqida: «yana qancha qolasiz?». **How long have you been here?** — o'tmishdan hozirgacha: «qanchadan beri shu yerdasiz?». **Since when ...?** ko'pincha ajablanish yoki norozilikni bildiradi: Since when do you drink coffee? — Qachondan beri qahva ichadigan bo'lib qolding?

items.text: **When did** you **arrive** in London? — Last Tuesday.
**How long have** you **been** here? — Almost a week now.
items.translation: Bu yerda **qanchadan beri** yuribsiz? — Mana, bir haftaga yaqin.

items.text: **How long are** you **staying**? — Until the end of the month.

blocks.text: since + to'liq gap: since I left school

since dan keyin faqat sana emas, butun bir gap ham kelishi mumkin. Bu gap odatda **Past Simple** da bo'ladi, chunki u boshlanish nuqtasini — bir martalik o'tgan voqeani bildiradi: since I **left** school, since we **moved** here, since she **was** a child. Asosiy gap esa Present Perfect da: I**'ve worked** in a bank since I left school. O'zbekchada bu «**-gan(im)dan beri**»: maktabni **bitirganimdan beri**. **ever since** — kuchaytirilgan «o'shandan beri»; since gap oxirida yolg'iz ham keladi: He left in May and I haven't seen him **since** (o'shandan beri).

items.text: I've wanted to be a pilot **since I was** six.
A lot has changed **since you left**.
They argued in June and haven't spoken **since**.
items.translation: Ular iyunda janjallashib qolishdi va **o'shandan beri** gaplashishmaydi.

blocks.text: for qachon tushib qoladi, qachon umuman kerak emas

Og'zaki nutqda, darak gapda **for** ba'zan tushiriladi: I've been here **three weeks** (= for three weeks). Inkor gapda esa for saqlanadi: I haven't seen her **for** three weeks. **all** bilan for umuman ishlatilmaydi: I've been working **all day** («for all day» emas), She's lived here **all her life**. **for ages** va **for a long time** — «ancha vaqtdan beri»; ayniqsa inkor gapda tabiiy: I haven't been to the theatre **for ages**.

**It's** (= It is; ba'zan It**'s been**) + muddat + **since** + Past Simple — biror voqea oxirgi marta bo'lganidan beri qancha vaqt o'tganini aytadi. Bu o'zbekchadagi «**ko'rganimga ikki yil bo'ldi**» qolipining aynan o'zi. Savol shakli — **How long is it since** ...? (= ...ga qancha bo'ldi?). Xuddi shu fikrni inkor Present Perfect bilan ham aytish mumkin. E'tibor bering: o'zbekchada ko'pincha inkor ishlatiladi («**ko'rmaganimga** ikki yil bo'ldi»), inglizchada esa since dan keyingi gap **darak**: since I last **saw** him.

rows: We **haven't been** to the cinema **for** ages.
Aziz chekishni tashlaganiga olti oy bo'ldi.

items.text: **How long is it since** you **saw** your parents?
**It's been** a long time **since** I **felt** this tired.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I live here since 2018» → I**'ve lived** here since 2018 (o'zbekcha «yashayman» hozirgi zamonda, inglizchada esa Present Perfect kerak); «since two years» → **for** two years; «for Monday» → **since** Monday; «When have you come?» → **When did** you come?; «It's two years since I didn't see him» → since I **saw** him (inkor kerak emas); «I've been working for all day» → **all day**; «How long are you living here?» → How long **have** you **lived** here?

Tanlash usuli: «-dan beri» oldidagi so'zga **How long?** savolini bering. U javob bo'la olsa (ikki soat, uch yil, ancha vaqt) — **for**. Agar u **When?** savoliga javob bo'lsa (dushanba, 2020-yil, to'y, bolaligim) — **since**. for — chizg'ich bilan uzunlik o'lchash, since — kalendarga barmoq qo'yish.

examples.title: **for** + a period: for six months, for ages
examples.description: for — muddat uzunligi: for three days, for a long time, for ages. Present Perfect (Simple yoki Continuous) bilan — hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat.

sentences.text: Kate has been a nurse **for twelve years** and still loves the job.
sentences.translation: Keyt **o'n ikki yildan beri** hamshira va bu ishni hali ham yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: We've been waiting for the plumber **for over two hours**.
sentences.translation: Santexnikni **ikki soatdan ortiq vaqtdan beri** kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: My grandparents have been married **for almost fifty years**.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim turmush qurganiga **qariyb ellik yil** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Aziz hasn't had a proper holiday **for three years** because of his business.
sentences.translation: Aziz biznesi tufayli **uch yildan beri** yaxshilab dam olmagan.

sentences.text: How are you? I haven't heard from you **for ages**!
sentences.translation: Qalaysan? Sendan **ancha vaqtdan beri** xabar yo'q!

sentences.text: The lift in our building has been out of order **for a week**.
sentences.translation: Binomizdagi lift **bir haftadan beri** ishlamayapti.

sentences.text: Sarah has been learning Uzbek **for six months**, and she can already chat with taxi drivers.
sentences.translation: Sara **olti oydan beri** o'zbek tilini o'rganyapti va taksi haydovchilari bilan bemalol suhbatlasha oladi.

sentences.text: Nobody has lived in that old house on the corner **for decades**.
sentences.translation: Burchakdagi o'sha eski uyda **o'nlab yillardan beri** hech kim yashamaydi.

sentences.text: **For the last few weeks**, Jasur has been going to the gym every morning.
sentences.translation: **So'nggi bir necha haftadan beri** Jasur har tong sport zaliga qatnayapti.

sentences.text: Have you had this cough **for a long time**, or did it start recently?
sentences.translation: Bu yo'tal sizda **ancha vaqtdan beri** bormi yoki yaqinda boshlandimi?

examples.title: **since** + a point in time: since May, since 2019
examples.description: since — harakat boshlangan nuqta: kun, oy, yil, voqea. O'zbekchada ham «-dan beri», lekin undan oldin muddat emas, aniq payt turadi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has worked at the children's hospital **since 2019**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **2019-yildan beri** bolalar shifoxonasida ishlaydi.

sentences.text: It has been raining non-stop **since Monday morning**.
sentences.translation: **Dushanba ertalabdan beri** tinimsiz yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: I haven't eaten anything **since breakfast**, so I'm starving.
sentences.translation: **Nonushtadan beri** hech narsa yemadim, qornim juda och.

sentences.text: Oliver has been a vegetarian **since his trip to India** last year.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'tgan yilgi **Hindiston safaridan beri** vegetarian.

sentences.text: Prices at this café have nearly doubled **since the summer**.
sentences.translation: **Yozdan beri** bu kafedagi narxlar deyarli ikki baravar oshdi.

sentences.text: **Since the pandemic**, many companies have let their staff work from home.
sentences.translation: **Pandemiyadan beri** ko'plab kompaniyalar xodimlariga uydan ishlashga ruxsat berib kelmoqda.

sentences.text: Madina and Kate have been best friends **since primary school**.
sentences.translation: Madina va Keyt **boshlang'ich maktabdan beri** eng yaqin dugonalar.

sentences.text: Has anyone called **since lunchtime**? I'm expecting a message from the bank.
sentences.translation: **Tushlikdan beri** kimdir qo'ng'iroq qildimi? Bankdan xabar kutyapman.

sentences.text: The road to Khiva has been closed **since last Friday** because of the floods.
sentences.translation: Toshqin tufayli Xivaga boradigan yo'l **o'tgan jumadan beri** yopiq.

sentences.text: We've had this washing machine **since our wedding**, and it still works perfectly.
sentences.translation: Bu kir yuvish mashinasi bizda **to'yimizdan beri** bor va hali ham a'lo ishlaydi.

examples.title: Length and starting point: **for** ... **since** ...
examples.description: Bir gapda ikkalasi: muddat (for) va boshlanish nuqtasi (since). Bir xil «-dan beri» ning ikki xil tarjimasini his qilish uchun.

sentences.text: Bekzod has worked at the bank **for six years** — **since he was twenty-two**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bankda **olti yildan beri** — **yigirma ikki yoshidan beri** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: I've known Emma **for ten years**, **since our first day** at university.
sentences.translation: Emmani **o'n yildan beri**, universitetdagi **birinchi kunimizdan beri** taniyman.

sentences.text: The museum has been closed **for a month**, **since the start** of the repairs.
sentences.translation: Muzey **bir oydan beri**, ya'ni ta'mir **boshlanganidan beri** yopiq.

sentences.text: James hasn't smoked **for three years** — not **since his heart attack**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **uch yildan beri** — **infarktdan beri** chekmaydi.

sentences.text: We've had no hot water **since Tuesday**; we've managed without it **for four days** now.
sentences.translation: **Seshanbadan beri** issiq suvimiz yo'q; mana **to'rt kundan beri** usiz yashayapmiz.

sentences.text: Nilufar has been teaching **since she was twenty**, so **for nearly fifteen years** now.
sentences.translation: Nilufar **yigirma yoshidan beri** dars beradi — demak, mana **qariyb o'n besh yildan beri**.

sentences.text: How long has Tom been in hospital? — **Since Sunday**, so **for five days**.
sentences.translation: Tom qanchadan beri kasalxonada? — **Yakshanbadan beri**, ya'ni **besh kundan beri**.

sentences.text: The two countries have been partners **for decades**, **since the 1990s**.
sentences.translation: Ikki davlat **o'nlab yillardan beri** — **1990-yillardan beri** hamkor.

sentences.text: My phone has been acting strangely **for a few days** — ever **since I dropped it**.
sentences.translation: Telefonim **bir necha kundan beri** — uni **tushirib yuborganimdan beri** g'alati ishlayapti.

sentences.text: Have you been waiting **for long**? — No, only **since ten past five**.
sentences.translation: **Ko'pdan beri** kutyapsizmi? — Yo'q, faqat **beshdan o'n daqiqa o'tgandan beri**.

examples.title: **since** + a past event: since I left school
examples.description: since dan keyin to'liq gap keladi — u Past Simple da (bir martalik boshlanish nuqtasi), asosiy gap esa Present Perfect da. O'zbekchada «-gan(im)dan beri».

sentences.text: Jasur has changed jobs three times **since he left university**.
sentences.translation: Jasur **universitetni tugatganidan beri** uch marta ish almashtirdi.

sentences.text: **Since we moved** to Tashkent, the children have made lots of new friends.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga **ko'chib kelganimizdan beri** bolalar ko'plab yangi do'stlar orttirishdi.

sentences.text: I haven't been to the cinema **since my daughter was born**.
sentences.translation: **Qizim tug'ilganidan beri** kinoga borganim yo'q.

sentences.text: How much weight have you lost **since you started** running?
sentences.translation: Yugurishni **boshlaganingizdan beri** qancha vazn yo'qotdingiz?

sentences.text: Madina's English has improved enormously **since she moved** to London.
sentences.translation: Londonga **ko'chib ketganidan beri** Madinaning ingliz tili ancha yaxshilandi.

sentences.text: Nothing has been the same in the office **since Kate retired**.
sentences.translation: **Keyt nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri** ofisda hech narsa avvalgidek emas.

sentences.text: **Ever since I read** that article, I've been worried about sugar.
sentences.translation: O'sha maqolani **o'qiganimdan beri** shakar haqida xavotirdaman.

sentences.text: Has Oliver phoned you **since you had** that argument?
sentences.translation: **Janjallashib qolganingizdan beri** Oliver sizga qo'ng'iroq qildimi?

sentences.text: The town has grown a lot **since the factory opened** in the nineties.
sentences.translation: To'qsoninchi yillarda **zavod ochilganidan beri** shaharcha ancha o'sdi.

sentences.text: We've been much happier **since we stopped** watching the news every evening.
sentences.translation: Har kecha yangiliklarni ko'rishni **to'xtatganimizdan beri** ancha baxtliroqmiz.

examples.title: **When did** ...? or **How long have** ...?
examples.description: When ...? — boshlanish payti (Past Simple), How long ...? — hozirgacha qancha vaqt (Present Perfect). How long are you staying? — kelajak haqida.

sentences.text: **When did** you **start** this job? — Last September, right after graduation.
sentences.translation: Bu ishni **qachon boshladingiz**? — O'tgan sentyabrda, o'qishni bitirgan zahoti.

sentences.text: **How long have** you **had** your driving licence? — Only since March.
sentences.translation: Haydovchilik guvohnomangiz **qachondan beri bor**? — Faqat martdan beri.

sentences.text: **When did** Aziz and Madina **get** married? — Three years ago, in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Aziz va Madina **qachon turmush qurishgan**? — Uch yil oldin, Samarqandda.

sentences.text: Your parents look so happy together — **how long have** they **been** married?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz birga juda baxtli ko'rinadi — turmush **qurganlariga qancha bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: So you're learning the guitar! **When did** you **begin**?
sentences.translation: Demak, gitara chalishni o'rganyapsan! **Qachon boshlading**?

sentences.text: Do you know **how long** Sarah **has had** her own business?
sentences.translation: Saraning o'z biznesi **qachondan beri borligini** bilasizmi?

sentences.text: **What time did** the meeting **begin**? It**'s been going on** for hours!
sentences.translation: Majlis soat **nechada boshlangan**? Soatlardan beri **davom etyapti**-ku!

sentences.text: **How long have** you **been** in Edinburgh, and **how long are** you **staying**?
sentences.translation: Edinburgda **qanchadan beri** yuribsiz va yana **qancha qolasiz**?

sentences.text: **Since when has** Jasur **been** interested in politics? He never cared about the news!
sentences.translation: Jasur **qachondan beri** siyosatga qiziqadigan bo'lib qoldi? U yangiliklarga umuman qiziqmas edi-ku!

sentences.text: Kate, **when was** the last time you **saw** a dentist? — Honestly, I can't remember.
sentences.translation: Keyt, tish shifokorida oxirgi marta **qachon bo'lgansiz**? — Rostini aytsam, eslolmayman.

examples.title: **It's** two years **since** ...
examples.description: It's (= It is) + muddat + since + Past Simple: «...ga ... bo'ldi». How long is it since ...? — «...ga qancha bo'ldi?». Since dan keyin inglizchada darak gap.

sentences.text: **It's** two years **since** I last **saw** my cousins in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Farg'onadagi amakivachchalarimni oxirgi marta **ko'rganimga ikki yil bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: **How long is it since** you **had** a proper day off?
sentences.translation: Oxirgi marta to'liq **dam olganingizga qancha bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: **It's been** ages **since** we **went** out for dinner together.
sentences.translation: Birga kechki ovqatga **chiqmaganimizga ancha bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Wow, **it's** almost ten years **since** we **finished** school!
sentences.translation: Voy, maktabni **bitirganimizga qariyb o'n yil bo'libdi**!

sentences.text: Grandma says **it's** months **since** anyone **visited** her.
sentences.translation: Buvimning aytishicha, uni kimdir **yo'qlab kelganiga oylar bo'libdi**.

sentences.text: **Is it** really five years **since** Tom **moved** to Australia?
sentences.translation: Tomning Avstraliyaga **ko'chib ketganiga** rostdan **besh yil bo'ldimi**?

sentences.text: I can't believe **it's** a whole year **since** I **started** this course.
sentences.translation: Bu kursni **boshlaganimga** butun **bir yil bo'lganiga** ishonolmayman.

sentences.text: Our neighbours complain that **it's** weeks **since** the rubbish **was collected**.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz chiqindi **haftalardan beri olib ketilmayotganidan** shikoyat qilishyapti.

sentences.text: **How long has it been since** you **spoke** to your brother? — Nearly a month, sadly.
sentences.translation: Akangiz bilan **gaplashmaganingizga qancha bo'ldi**? — Afsuski, qariyb bir oy.

sentences.text: Oliver is really proud: **it's** three months **since** he **smoked** a cigarette.
sentences.translation: Oliver o'zidan juda faxrlanadi: sigaret **chekmaganiga uch oy bo'ldi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: bumping into an old classmate
examples.description: Ikki sobiq sinfdosh tasodifan uchrashib qoladi: It's ... since, How long ...?, When did ...?, for va since bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Nilufar? I don't believe it! **It's** years **since** we last **met**!
sentences.translation: — Nilufar? Ishonmayman! Oxirgi marta **ko'rishganimizga necha yillar bo'ldi**!

sentences.text: — Bekzod! Yes, **it's been** at least eight years, I think.
sentences.translation: — Bekzod! Ha, menimcha, kamida **sakkiz yil bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — So where are you working now? **How long have** you **been** there?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, hozir qayerda ishlayapsan? U yerda **qanchadan beri** ishlaysan?

sentences.text: — At a travel company in Bukhara — **since last spring**, actually.
sentences.translation: — Buxorodagi turizm kompaniyasida — aslida **o'tgan bahordan beri**.

sentences.text: — Great! And **when did** you **decide** to leave the bank?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Bankdan ketishga **qachon qaror qilding**?

sentences.text: — About two years ago, and I **haven't regretted** it **for a second**.
sentences.translation: — Taxminan ikki yil oldin, va **bir soniya ham afsuslanmadim**.

sentences.text: — And are you still with Jasur? You've been together **since university**!
sentences.translation: — Jasur bilan hali ham birgamisizlar? **Universitetdan beri** birgasizlar-ku!

sentences.text: — We are! We**'ve been** married **for four years** and have a daughter now.
sentences.translation: — Ha! Turmush qurganimizga **to'rt yil bo'ldi**, endi qizimiz ham bor.

sentences.text: — Wonderful! Listen, **it's been** far too long **since** our last proper chat.
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! Qara, oxirgi marta yaxshilab **gaplashganimizga juda uzoq vaqt bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: — You're right. Let's meet on Saturday — I **haven't been** to a nice café **for weeks**.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri aytasan. Shanba kuni uchrashamiz — **haftalardan beri** yaxshi kafeda **bo'lmadim**.

examples.title: Mixed: for, since, all day, ago and It's ... since
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: for / since, all day (for siz), since gap oxirida, ago bilan Past Simple, It's ... since — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: I've been on my feet **all day**, so I'm going to have a long hot bath.
sentences.translation: **Kun bo'yi** tik oyoqda yurdim, endi issiq vannada uzoq yotaman.

sentences.text: Bekzod moved to Manchester two years ago, and he**'s lived** there ever **since**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ikki yil oldin Manchesterga ko'chib ketgan va **o'shandan beri** o'sha yerda **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: The company has been losing money **for the last three quarters**.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya **so'nggi uch chorakdan beri** zarar ko'ryapti.

sentences.text: Kate has lived in the same village **all her life** and doesn't want to leave.
sentences.translation: Keyt **butun umri** bitta qishloqda yashab keladi va ketishni istamaydi.

sentences.text: **Since** the new bridge **opened**, it's taken me only twenty minutes to get to work.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'prik **ochilganidan beri** ishga borishga atigi yigirma daqiqa sarflayapman.

sentences.text: Nobody has heard from Tom **since** he **left** for Canada a month ago.
sentences.translation: Tom bir oy oldin Kanadaga **ketganidan beri** undan hech kim xabar topmadi.

sentences.text: Economists point out that **it's** four years **since** the government last **raised** the minimum wage.
sentences.translation: Iqtisodchilarning ta'kidlashicha, hukumat eng kam ish haqini oxirgi marta **oshirganiga to'rt yil bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: I've had this laptop **since my student days**, so it's nearly ten years old.
sentences.translation: Bu noutbuk menda **talabalik yillarimdan beri** bor, demak, unga qariyb o'n yil bo'ldi.

sentences.text: We haven't had a single day of rain **for over two months**, and the farmers are worried.
sentences.translation: **Ikki oydan ortiq vaqtdan beri** bir kun ham yomg'ir yog'madi, fermerlar xavotirda.

sentences.text: The doctor wants to know **when** the pain first **appeared** and **how long** it's been getting worse.
sentences.translation: Shifokor og'riq **qachon paydo bo'lganini** va **qanchadan beri** kuchayib borayotganini bilmoqchi.
